Senior Data Analyst — Lumen Analytics (Pune, hybrid)

Lumen Analytics helps mid-size retailers understand their customers. We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Insights team and own analyses from question to recommendation.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau that leadership uses every week
- Write complex SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse
- Design, run and analyse A/B tests with the product team
- Build forecasting models in Python (pandas, scikit-learn)
- Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders
- Mentor two junior analysts

What we're looking for (required)
- 4+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field
- Expert SQL and strong Python
- Experience with a BI tool (Power BI or Tableau)
- Experience designing and analysing A/B tests

Nice to have
- Snowflake or dbt experience
- Retail or e-commerce domain knowledge
- Airflow or another orchestration tool
- Experience mentoring other analysts

Senior Data Analyst | SQL, Python, Tableau
priya.sharma@example.com | +91 98765 43210 | Pune, India | linkedin.com/in/priya-sharma-example

Summary
Data analyst with 4 years of experience turning retail sales and operations data into actionable business insights. Proven track record of owning end-to-end analyses, from SQL extraction and A/B testing to Tableau dashboard creation and stakeholder presentations.

Skills

Tools & Technologies: Tableau, Excel, Airflow, Git

• Collaborated with cross-functional finance and supply chain teams to define key performance indicators and deliver stakeholder presentations.
Junior Analyst | Contoso Logistics | Mumbai, India | Jul 2020 – Dec 2021

• Created quantitative Excel models to forecast weekly delivery volumes for logistics operations.
• Fulfilled 120 ad hoc data analysis requests for operations managers to support daily operational decisions.

questions.question: Can you share the story behind your A/B test on checkout process modifications at Northwind Retail that lifted conversion by 6 percent?

formatAdvice.reason: The role lists concrete technical requirements like SQL, A/B testing, and Python, and your resume has strong measurable results that map directly onto them.

answers.question: Can you share the story behind your A/B test on checkout process modifications at Northwind Retail that lifted conversion by 6 percent?
answers.answer: The test showed no lift for two weeks. I split the results by device and saw mobile users dropping at the address form, so we cut it to three fields. That is where the 6% came from.

answers.question: What specifically drew you to apply to Lumen Analytics and our focus on helping mid-size retailers understand their customers?
answers.answer: My first job was helping in my uncle's shop. He never had time for reports, so tools that make data simple for small retailers matter to me.

answers.question: If your approach to untangling messy data warehouses like Snowflake or SQL tables was a hobby or craft, what would it be?
answers.answer: I bake sourdough at weekends. You feed the starter a little at a time and watch it before you trust it, which is how I treat a new metric.

Dear Lumen Analytics hiring team,

My first job was helping in my uncle's shop. He never had time for reports, so tools that make data simple for small retailers matter to me. I've spent four years doing this work at Northwind Retail, and I want to bring that experience to your Insights team as a Senior Data Analyst.

- Built 12 Tableau dashboards used weekly by 40 regional managers to track retail sales performance.
- Designed and analysed A/B tests on checkout process modifications, splitting results by device to spot mobile drop-offs at the address form and cutting it down to three fields, resulting in a 6% conversion rate lift.
- Automated monthly revenue reporting workflows using Python and SQL, reducing preparation time from 3 days to 4 hours.

I bake sourdough at weekends. You feed the starter a little at a time and watch it before you trust it, which is how I treat a new metric. Let's talk about how I can help your team own analyses from question to recommendation.

Best regards,
Priya Sharma
